tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Screen ground behind every panel. Classic: drafting paper. Ledger: cool planner paper. Glass: base under the aurora blobs.

tokens.name: sunk
tokens.usage: Wells cut into a panel: inputs, map viewports, meter tracks. Glass: a clearer pane, not a darker one.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Panel body. Glass values are translucent and need backdrop-filter (bundle.css does it).

tokens.name: raise
tokens.usage: Table heads, stat tiles, hovered rows — one step up from panel.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Default hairline: panel borders, row rules.

tokens.name: line-hi
tokens.usage: Emphasised border: focused or lit panel, active tab. 3:1 on canvas in every theme.

tokens.name: bevel-hi
tokens.usage: Top-left bevel edge (Classic) / specular top rim (Glass).

tokens.name: bevel-lo
tokens.usage: Bottom-right bevel edge; pressed state inverts the pair.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and readouts.

tokens.name: ink-mute
tokens.usage: Secondary text, table cells.

tokens.name: ink-dim
tokens.usage: Labels, axis ticks, timestamps. 4.5:1 on canvas and panel.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled text, grid dots. Decoration only — fails text contrast by design.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: THE action colour: Classic title bars, primary button fill, user chat bubble. Czech flag blue in every theme.

tokens.name: accent-hi
tokens.usage: Hover / lit state of accent fills, focus ring, Ledger tab stripe.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Accent used AS TEXT: links, key hints, tool-call lines, stat values. 4.5:1 on canvas and panel.

tokens.name: accent-faint
tokens.usage: Tinted fills: hovered row, chart band, Ledger selection ground.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill.

tokens.name: select
tokens.usage: Selected row / list item ground. Ledger selects with a tint + accent bar instead of a fill.

tokens.name: on-select
tokens.usage: Text on a select ground.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: STATE ONLY — failure, disarmed, critical. Never decoration, never a brand fill. Czech flag red, lifted in dark.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text on a signal chip; bold 700, always a word.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Healthy / READY. Deliberately blue-side (not green) so ok and signal differ in hue AND lightness.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Degraded / slow / approaching a limit.

tokens.name: unknown
tokens.usage: UNKNOWN — an unreadable source. Always dashed and labelled; never green, never empty.

tokens.name: data-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 (the series the screen is about).

tokens.name: data-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2; KEAP memory cluster in Explore.

tokens.name: data-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3.

tokens.name: data-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4.

tokens.name: data-5
tokens.usage: Chart 'other' bucket and graph edges.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: Halo behind a lit node; Glass: the cool aurora blob.

tokens.name: glow-2
tokens.usage: Second halo; Glass: the warm aurora blob.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Landing and cover headline only (t-5). Letter-spacing -0.015em.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The AIT / nOS wordmark — always the mono face, tracked 0.18em.

styles.name: label-caps
styles.usage: Panel title bars, column heads, state tags. UPPERCASE, tracked 0.16em.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Section kicker above a title, in accent-soft. Tracked 0.22em.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Big numbers in stat tiles and meters. Tabular figures.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Table cells, logs, key/value rows, tool-call lines.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Graph node labels, axis ticks, minimap. Minimum size in the system.

styles.name: ui
styles.sample: Ukaž mi řádky se statusem next

styles.name: ui-strong
styles.usage: Selected item, button label, inspector value.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Long-form copy: manifesto, tutorials, docs. Never inside a HUD panel.
styles.sample: Jeden stack. Čtyřicet služeb. Žádné SaaS předplatné.

styles.name: lede
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a display headline, with a 3px accent left rule.
styles.sample: Nová kategorie infrastruktury — self-hosted, agentní, open-source.

tokens.name: s-00
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: tag inner padding, meter segment gap.

tokens.name: s-0
tokens.usage: Dense gap: icon to label, row cell padding-y, panel gutter in HUD screens.

tokens.name: s-1
tokens.usage: Base step (source 8pt grid): panel padding, control padding-x.

tokens.name: s-2
tokens.usage: Gap between panel groups; landing card padding.

tokens.name: s-3
tokens.usage: Landing section padding. Too loose for HUD screens.

tokens.name: s-4
tokens.usage: Landing vertical rhythm.

tokens.name: s-6
tokens.usage: Hero spacing.

tokens.name: s-8
tokens.usage: Page bottom, between landing sections.

tokens.name: r-0
tokens.usage: Default for Classic and Ledger panels: square windows.

tokens.name: r-1
tokens.usage: Classic / Ledger controls, tags, meter tracks.

tokens.name: r-2
tokens.usage: Glass controls, tags, stat tiles, map nodes.

tokens.name: r-3
tokens.usage: Glass panels and the topbar — the only large radius in the system.

tokens.name: r-pill
tokens.usage: Scrollbar thumbs and the Iris pupil. Nothing else.

size.note: Fixed HUD dimensions — the density contract.

tokens.name: row
tokens.usage: Table / list row height in HUD screens.

tokens.name: bar
tokens.usage: Panel title bar and keybar height.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Button and input height.

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: Left rail width in a three-pane screen.

tokens.name: inspector
tokens.usage: Right inspector width in a three-pane screen.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Panel elevation: bevel (Classic), hairline drop (Ledger), specular rim + soft lift (Glass).

tokens.name: shadow-press
tokens.usage: Pressed button, active toggle, sunk well.

tokens.name: shadow-lit
tokens.usage: Lit / selected panel or node; doubles as the visible focus ring.

derivedFrom.note: AIT brand v0.3 (Czech blue, red state-only, font set) + the Textual reader palette
